requirements.text: Customers should be able to book their appointments online at any time.
Customers should have the ability to cancel or change their appointments without needing to call.
The system should send reminders to customers to help them remember their appointments.
Each barber should be able to set their own working hours and breaks.
The system should prevent double bookings by ensuring that a time slot is not available if a barber is already scheduled.
A feature that tracks when customers do not show up for their appointments.
The ability to monitor which customers are frequent no-shows to determine if any special handling is needed.
The system should remain affordable and easy to use.
